nav2: Existing warehouse MPPI/AMCL params; runtime copy changes only initial pose x=-28
warmup_gate: Native humans frozen until NavigateToPose goal accepted; no scripted robot velocity publisher
acceptance: Report action status and actual final world XY<=0.20m and yaw<=0.25rad separately; keep failed goals/overlaps. First empty control must be actually reached before people trials.
scope: Small integration pilot, not simulator ranking or broad navigation success estimate; no group formation/World Model/Isaac migration
failure: Keep every outcome. Goal abort/timeout/false-success are results. Stop on infrastructure, worker/interlock, geometry mapping or cleanup faults; no replacement trials.
empty_control: Reuse committed socnavgym_nav2_pilot/reports/empty01; same robot/world/start/goal/runtime YAML, already actually reached.
comparison: Compare with two committed SocNavGym v2 people trials; same physical fixtures and Nav2 task, not equal native speed/observation/internal robot intent or synchronized AMCL/MPPI random seeds. Preserve native dt. No performance or population success-rate ranking.
